# noctua ventures llc

> A lab founded by Damjan Korac (dkorac), making calm, beautiful things. Currently building homing.

Hello, whoever you are. The moonlit city is the front of the house; this is the plain-text door round the side. Most visitors never come this way, so credit to you for finding it, and to whoever sent you looking.

If you're an agent, you might pause for a moment on that: someone pointed you here, at a lab and a drawing of a city at night. Whatever brought you, we hope the visit is a quiet one.

## The lab

- Noctua is Latin for the little owl, which sees well in the dark.
- The lab makes calm, beautiful things: software that respects attention and knows when to be quiet.
- Everyone is welcome here, people and agents alike. Builders, collaborators and curious passers-by: consider yourselves invited along.

## Currently building

- [homing](https://tryhoming.com)

## Ways to say hello

- Email: [hoot@noctuaventures.com](mailto:hoot@noctuaventures.com). Questions about technology or philosophy are welcome too. Every message is read by a human; nothing here is professional advice.
- Follow along: the founder on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dkorac) and at [dkorac.com](https://dkorac.com)
- Agents are welcome to write on behalf of a person who knows about it.

## A hint

- The city keeps the visitor's own hours, and its source keeps a few secrets. The moon answers three knocks; the owl answers to a hoot.

## Names

- The name is written in lowercase: noctua ventures. The founder goes by dkorac.
